name: Job Digest — Already Applied?
description: Shows a banner on any job posting telling you whether you've already applied, so you never apply twice.

content_scripts.comment: Loads on all pages AND embedded frames so company-hosted job boards (e.g. a Greenhouse board embedded via an iframe on oldmissioncapital.com) are covered -- the job description often lives in the frame, not the top page. The banner renders only in the top frame; child frames just pass their text up for keyword extraction. Makes zero network calls, so nothing ever leaves the browser.
